title: Terminal plugin main.js code patches
why: Three code edits to the Polyipseity terminal plugin's bundled main.js that have no settings exposure. (1) Hotkey passthrough: while a terminal is focused the plugin re-bakes Obsidian's hotkey table to a hardcoded whitelist Set; we prepend the tab-switch, new-terminal, settings, and zen-mode command ids so those hotkeys still reach Obsidian instead of falling through to the shell. (2) Strip the 'Terminal: ' tab-title prefix by simplifying getDisplayText() to return the bare name. (3) Focus on activate: the plugin's active-leaf-change handler only records the last non-terminal leaf and never focuses a terminal when its leaf becomes active, so switching to a terminal pane via a tab-switch hotkey leaves keyboard focus outside the xterm input (user must click in). We augment the handler so that when the activated leaf's view is the terminal class it calls the view's own focus(), guarded by document.hasFocus() so focus only moves while the Obsidian window is already foregrounded (the interactive tab-switch case) and the OS window is never pulled forward during background/programmatic activations. Reapply after any terminal plugin update.
